notes.decision: Rendered as proper name 'Panaretos' per accumulated vocabulary — the eschatological All-Virtuous figure who comes against the bōlos at the dissolution.
Read as 'first place' — ⲙⲁϩ = ⲙⲁ 'place'; ⲍⲟⲩⲓⲧⲉ = Lyc. for 'first' (cf. Sahidic ϣⲟⲣⲡ̄/ⲛ̄ϣⲁⲣⲡ̄). The 'first place' is the original abode from which the apostles/light-emanations came forth.
Lycopolitan beatitude formula = Sahidic ⲛⲁⲓ̈ⲁⲧϥ̄ 'blessed is.' Standard 'blessed is every man who...' construction.
Marginal numeral '20' marking the chapter boundary, repeated in the heading line. Treated as a structural marker rather than a textual line.

Chapter heading 'The Names of the Fathers' — using accumulated vocabulary entry ⲛⲓ̈ⲁⲧⲉ = the divine Fathers (Lyc. plural of ⲓⲱⲧ); chapter enumerates titles applied to each Manichaean divine emanation.
ⲧⲣⲉⲛ = ϯ-ⲣⲉⲛ 'give a name to' (Lyc. ⲣⲉⲛ for ⲣⲉⲛ; cf. ϯⲡⲉⲛ in accumulated vocab). The construction is 'whom they name (lit. give-name to him).' Rendered idiomatically as 'name.'
ⲉⲧⲃⲉ ⲉⲩ ⲛ̄ⲍⲱⲃ = 'on account of what thing' = 'for what reason / why?' Standard interrogative collocation.

Per accumulated vocabulary: 'the Great Land' = the technical Manichaean designation for the Land of Light, the Father's own region. The Father IS the Greatness IS the Great Land — direct correspondential identification.

Per accumulated vocabulary: 'bear, lift up' (used of Pillar of Glory bearing cosmic burdens). Here applied to the substance of Light bearing up under all gods, angels, and dwellings — the cosmological ground.

Tentatively read as 'unto fullness/completion' — ⲁ- (preposition 'to') + ⲭⲱϩ possibly related to ϫⲱⲕ 'complete.' Could alternatively be a defective writing of ⲁⲭⲱⲱϩ or ⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ. Sense is 'permanently established.' Confidence low.

'The Vessel of Light of the Living Fire' — ⲭⲁⲓ̈ per accumulated vocab as 'vessel/frame' (cf. ⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲛⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ = ship of fire = sun in earlier kephalaia). Identifying the Third Ambassador with the solar light-vessel, the cosmic sun-ship.
